Problem
College club athletes do not have 
the ﬁnances to purchase multiple 
pairs of cleats for the various sports 
they play.

Solution
The Chameleon:
a versatile athletic shoe with 
interchangeable and 
detachable soles for various 
sports, crafting the ultimate 
adaptable sports playing 
experience for our consumers

Value Proposition 
FOR young adult sports players on a budget
WHO NEED to ﬁnd aﬀordable options to participate in sports of 
interest
THE Chameleon is a sports sneaker that converts into a cleat or sports 
shoe of the buyer's choice 
THAT provides functionality at a reasonable price
UNLIKE traditional sports cleats and sports shoes that are limited to 
only one sport per pair of shoes, making sports less accessible for 
those that don't have much expendable income.
